question: Where was the 12th Regional 3R and Circular Economy Forum in Asia and the Pacific held?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Jaipur**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Jaipur: 12th Regional 3R and Circular Economy Forum in Asia and the Pacific.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **India’s circular economy** is projected to generate a market value of over **$2 trillion** and create **10 million jobs** by **2050**.
 
• **Bhupender Yadav** highlighted India’s candidacy to host the **World Circular Economy Forum** in **2026**.
 
• Every year, the World Circular Economy Forum is organized, and in 2025, it will be held in São Paulo, Brazil.
 
• The **Plastic Waste Management Rules (2016)** have targeted several sectors like **municipal, industrial, residential**, and **commercial**.
 
• India banned certain categories of **single-use plastics** through notification in **2022**.
 
• The **Mission 'LiFE'** initiative supports **Eco-Mark Rules** to promote environmentally friendly products and **circular economy** principles.
 
• The session included the launch of several key reports and the signing of important agreements, such as:
 
 
• **SBM Waste to Wealth PMS Portal**
 
• **IFC Document Reference Guide**
 
• **MoU Between CSIR and MoHUA**
 
• **Release of ‘India’s Circular Sutra’**
 
• **CEEW Report on Solid Waste Management in Million-Plus Cities**
